Kit summary

Fire Spear AttackBasic
Deals 2 stages of 140% ATK DMG and 140% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG each to a single enemy.
Flaming LotusActive
Deals 110% ATK DMG and 110% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG to all enemies, with a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Internal Injury] for 2 turns.
Lotus ResurrectionPassiveExclusive Lv.2
At the beginning of each wave and at the end of self turns, Nezha gains 2 layers of [Lotus Leaf], up to 5 layers can be owned. When any enemy triggers [Internal Injury], Nezha consumes 1 layer of [Lotus Leaf] to restore self HP by 7% of Max HP and Stance value by 10% of Max Stance value. Also, in each battle, Nezha can use the lotus to revive only once after he dies. Nezha will revive with 30% of Max HP after 3 turns and enter [Lotus Incarnation] status. When under [Lotus Incarnation] status, increases Nezha's Skill DMG dealt by 36%.
Sacred Fire Spear Lv.2When any enemy's HP is less than 50% for the first time, increases Nezha's Turn Meter by 15%. Also, when [Lotus Leaf] is triggered, increases Nezha's Turn Meter by 8%.
Sacred MeteorActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Nezha consumes 10% HP and 10% Stance value up to 4 times or until the corresponding attribute is less than 30% of its cap. For every 10% HP consumed, increases self Crit DMG by 20% until the end of the current turn. For every 10% Stance value consumed, increases self [Internal Injury] DMG by 12% until the end of the current turn. Afterward, deals 170% ATK DMG and 170% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG to all enemies.
Sacred Fire Spear Lv.1After Nezha consumes HP and Stance value because of casting Sacred Meteor, if self is not under [Lotus Incarnation] status, enters [Lotus Incarnation] status for 3 turns temporarily.
Sacred Fire Spear Lv.3Sacred Meteor: Increases DMG Bonus of Crit DMG and [Internal Injury] DMG to 150% of the original, lasting for 2 turns or until Nezha casts Sacred Meteor again.
